subject: Course project submission
body: Professor, I have completed the course project and uploaded the assignment. Could you confirm receipt?

subject: Interview availability
body: Thank you for the interview invitation for the software engineer position. I am available to discuss next steps.

subject: Dinner plans
body: Hi Maya, are we still meeting for dinner this weekend? Let me know what works.

subject: Revised assignment submission
body: I uploaded the revised assignment after incorporating the lecture feedback. Could you confirm the file opens correctly?

subject: Research paper feedback
body: I revised the research paper based on your comments and would appreciate feedback before the lecture.

subject: Recruiting follow-up
body: Following up on my job application. Please let me know whether the hiring team needs my resume.

subject: Family visit
body: We are planning a family visit next month. Would Saturday work for you?

subject: Checking in about the interview
body: Thanks again for speaking with me about the software engineer role. Please let me know if you need any further information from my application.

subject: Thesis meeting
body: Could we schedule a meeting to discuss my thesis and university research?

subject: Position update
body: The recruiting team reviewed your application for the position and would like to arrange an interview.
